plan.title: security(corepack): harden packageManager dispatch against shell injection (#2761)

narratives.Description: Harden Corepack package-manager dispatch so repository-controlled packageManager pins cannot become shell syntax. Preserve Windows .cmd shim launch without interpolating attacker-controlled strings through shell:true.
narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#2761

## What to build

Harden Corepack / package-manager dispatch so repository-controlled `package.json#packageManager` values cannot become shell syntax when `task build`, `task check`, or `engine:pm-run` runs. Preserve legitimate Windows `.cmd` shim dispatch without interpolating attacker-controlled strings through `shell: true`.

Extract the duplicated inline Node paths from `tasks/engine.yml` into one testable helper (e.g. `tasks/engine-pm-run.cjs`) consumed by both `pm-run` and `_ts-build`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `packageManager` pin capture accepts only exact `pnpm@<SemVer 2.0>` (including valid prerelease/build metadata)
- [ ] Non-semver / metacharacter / whitespace / non-pnpm pins are rejected before any child process starts
- [ ] Requested package script is validated against `package.json#scripts`
- [ ] POSIX execution uses `execFileSync` + argv array without `shell: true`
- [ ] Windows launches only allowlisted `pnpm` / `corepack` / `npm` shims through an explicit tightly quoted `cmd.exe` boundary
- [ ] PATH/PATHEXT probes stay separate from execution; dispatch order remains installed pnpm → pinned Corepack → unpinned Corepack
- [ ] Regression tests cover accept/reject pins, argv recording, sentinel-file proof that a malicious pin cannot run a second command, and no `shell: true` on the real execution path
- [ ] `task check` passes

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Extract duplicated Corepack dispatch from tasks/engine.yml into the tasks/engine-pm-run.cjs script module. 2) Validate packageManager pins before spawn and add fixture tests under tasks/engine-pm-run.test.cjs that verify reject/accept behavior and prove shell:true is absent on the execution path.
narratives.UserStory: As a deft operator, I want packageManager pins validated before Corepack dispatch, so that a malicious pin cannot execute arbitrary shell commands during task build.
